sloka: तथागतां तां व्यथितामनिन्दितां व्यपेतहर्षां परिदीनमानसाम् ।शुभां निमित्तानि शुभानि भेजिरे नरं श्रिया जुष्टमिवोपजीविनः ।। ५.२९.१।।।।
transliteration: tathāgatāṁ tāṁ vyathitāmaninditāṁ vyapetaharṣāṁ paridīnamānasām ।śubhāṁ nimittāni śubhāni bhejire naraṁ śriyā juṣṭamivopajīvinaḥ ।। 5.29.1।।।।

translations.english: Like wellwishers flocking round a person on whom fortune is smiling, omens foretelling auspicious happenings in near future appeared to Sita. She was unimpeachable. She was in agony, distressed in mind, bereft of all joy (now) standing under that Simsupa tree.
